test_objective: Check that one can create a context source registration with specific ID and expiration date

test_cases.name: 033_01_01 Create Context Source Registration Without Mode And Operation
test_cases.doc: Check that one can create a context source registration with specific ID and expiration date
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response for the operations:
        Delete Context Source Registration With Return with Response Status Code set to 201     and
        Delete Context Source Registration With Return with Response Header: Location containing $${registration_id}     and
        Retrieve Context Source Registration with Check Created Resource Set To and
            Query Parameter: 'ignored_keys' set to '${None}' list of keys
}
